description_sq:

description_en: 💫 An apartment that is not just a home, but an experience 💫 📍 Former Exhibition | 🌆 Premium location in the heart of the city 🏡 This apartment offers strong emotions, maximum comfort and elegance in every detail. 🆕 Newly furnished, previously uninhabited, built under the supervision of an architect, where every work has been followed to perfection. 🛋️ Luxurious & high-quality furnishings, for a life without compromises 📐 Intelligent space organization, where every square meter has its own function 📏 Net area: 95 m² 📏 Total area: 119 m² ☀️ Natural light all day long 🌅 Sun in the morning & lunch 🧭 Orientation South-East 🏢 Floor 8 🔐 Building with high security and correct administration 🛗 2 modern chip elevators (capacity 5 people) ✨ Ideal for those looking for urban style, tranquility and modern luxury 📞 For detailed information and private visit, contact.
